ex.en: You've just contradicted yourself.
ex.zh: 你恰好与你刚才说的自相矛盾。

ex.en: The two reports contradict each other.
ex.zh: 这两份报告相互矛盾。

ex.en: Further contradicting conventional wisdom, we found that women as well as men have lower levels of stress at work than at home.
ex.zh: 与传统智慧更为矛盾的是，我们发现不论女性还是男性，工作时都比在家中压力更小。

contradiction.usage: contradict 的派生词；n.矛盾，不一致；反驳，驳斥

ex.en: His public speeches are in direct contradiction to his personal lifestyle.
ex.zh: 他的公开言论与他本人的生活方式恰恰相反。

ex.en: There is a clear contradiction between the two witness statements.
ex.zh: 两份证人证言之间存在明显的矛盾。

ex.en: Demanding higher skills while cutting education funding seems a clear contradiction.
ex.zh: 一边要求更高的技能，一边削减教育经费，这似乎是明显的矛盾。

senses: adj. 相互矛盾的，对立的
contradictory.usage: adj.相互矛盾的，对立的；索引p405

ex.en: The argument is internally contradictory.
ex.zh: 论据本身自相矛盾。

ex.en: The two reports reach contradictory conclusions about the safety of the drug.
ex.zh: 两份报告就得出了相互矛盾的药物安全性结论。

ex.en: Voters received contradictory messages from the two main parties.
ex.zh: 选民从两大政党那里得到了相互矛盾的信息。

senses: adj. 相反的,对抗的;好与人作对的
n. 相反事物,反对,对立面
adj. 与之相异的；相对立的；相反的

ex.en: Contrary to popular belief, many cats dislike milk.
ex.zh: 与普遍的看法相反，许多猫不喜欢牛奶。

ex.en: Contrary to expectations, the tax cut did little to stimulate consumer spending.
ex.zh: 与预期相反，减税对刺激消费几乎没有起到作用。

ex.en: Contrary to what many parents assume, video games can improve certain mental skills.
ex.zh: 与许多家长的设想相反，电子游戏可以提高某些思维技能。

senses: v. 使成对比,使成对照;形成对比,显出明显的差异(with)

phrases.m: 相比之下 / 与……形成对比

contrast.usage: 辨析: contrast 常与 with 连用表(通过对比)显出差异; compare to 比喻,比作; compare with 与……比较；n./v.差异，对比；对照物；我们签合同(contract)之前，一定要多家对比(contrast)；vt.读[kən'trɑːst]；索引p405

ex.en: There is an obvious contrast between the cultures of East and West.
ex.zh: 东西方文化之间有明显的差异。

ex.en: In contrast with her quiet brother, she greets every stranger like an old friend.
ex.zh: 与沉默寡言的哥哥形成对比的是，她像对待老朋友一样招呼每个陌生人。

ex.en: The essay contrasts life in the capital with life in remote mountain villages.
ex.zh: 这篇文章将首都的生活与偏远山村的生活进行了对比。

contribute.usage: con-(共同)+tribut(给予)→大家一起给→贡献；[族] contribution n. 贡献；contributor n. 贡献者；v.捐赠，捐助；做贡献；con（共同）+tribut（=give，表示“给予”）+e→共同给出→捐献。；词根:con(表加强)+tribut(give给予)+e→无偿给予→捐献;

ex.en: Fresh air, enough exercise and nutritious food contribute to good health.
ex.zh: 新鲜空气、足够的运动和营养的食物有助于身体健康。

ex.en: His accomplishments may contribute to the solution of moral problems.
ex.zh: 他的成就可能有助于解决道德问题。

ex.en: The charity invited everyone to contribute to the fund for families affected by the flood.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构邀请大家为受洪水影响的家庭捐款。

contribution.usage: n.贡献；捐款；定期缴款； 稿件；n.贡献；捐款；定期缴款；稿 件；n.贡献例为2013年阅读；索引p405

ex.en: Therefore, everyone needs to find their extra—their unique value contribution.
ex.zh: 因而，每个人都必须找到自身的独特之处——自身特有的价值贡献。

ex.en: The scientist's contribution to climate research was recognised with an international prize.
ex.zh: 这位科学家对气候研究的贡献获得了国际奖项的认可。

ex.en: Employees can make voluntary contributions to the pension scheme.
ex.zh: 员工可以向养老金计划自愿缴款。

ex.en: She made a valuable contribution to the debate on education reform.
ex.zh: 她为教育改革辩论做出了宝贵贡献。

senses: n. 因素；做出贡献者；捐赠者

ex.en: Chronic stress is now recognised as a major contributor to heart disease among office workers.
ex.zh: 慢性压力如今被认定为上班族患心脏病的一个重要因素。

senses: a. 促成的；促进的；起作用的；需要受益人付钱的
adj. 促成的,促进的,起作用的

ex.en: Fatigue was ruled a contributory factor in the train accident.
ex.zh: 疲劳被认定为火车事故的一个促成因素。

ex.en: Poor diet is a contributory cause of many chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 不良饮食是许多慢性病的促成原因。

ex.en: Members pay contributory fees into the pension scheme each month.
ex.zh: 成员每月向养老金计划缴纳供款费用。

senses: v. 设计，想出，谋划，策划(坏事、恶事)
v. [一般后接不定式]设法做到
v. 设法做到，促成某事；策划
vt. 谋划，策划；设法做到
contrive.usage: con（一起）+tri（三）+ve（“我”）→我们三人一起“策划”才可能成功。；索引p405

ex.en: Evidence either way is weak, relying on contrived laboratory tests or sometimes unreliable self-reports.
ex.zh: 无论如何，证据都很薄弱，它们依赖于人为的实验室测试，有时（甚至）是不可靠的自陈报告。

ex.en: The gang contrived to rob the vault without setting off a single alarm.
ex.zh: 这伙人设法抢劫了金库，却没有触发任何警报。

ex.en: Somehow the negotiators contrived an agreement that both sides could accept.
ex.zh: 谈判代表们总算设法达成了双方都能接受的协议。

senses: n. 管理权；控制（或操纵）能力
control.usage: n.控制权；控制力 v.控制，管理；限制；操纵；lose control of失去（对某事物的）控制；take control of控制（某事物）；索引p405

ex.en: The central bank raised interest rates to control inflation.
ex.zh: 中央银行提高利率以控制通货膨胀。

ex.en: The driver lost control of the vehicle on the icy road.
ex.zh: 司机在结冰的路面上失去了对车辆的控制。

ex.en: Strict quality control keeps the factory's defect rate extremely low.
ex.zh: 严格的质量控制使这家工厂的次品率极低。

senses: adj. 可控制(或管理、操纵、支配)的
controllable.usage: adj.可控制的；可管理的；索引p405

ex.en: Doctors stress that high blood pressure is controllable with proper medication.
ex.zh: 医生强调，高血压通过适当用药是可以控制的。

ex.en: Engineers replaced the faulty valves to keep the reaction controllable.
ex.zh: 工程师更换了故障阀门，以使反应保持可控。

ex.en: Costs are only controllable when firms track them from day one.
ex.zh: 只有从第一天起就跟踪成本，企业才能控制成本。

senses: adj. 引起争论的,有争议的
adj. 有争议的，引发争论的
controversial.usage: adj.有争议的，引发争论的；索引p405

ex.en: A controversial plan to build a new road has met with protests.
ex.zh: 一项有争议的修建新路的计划遭到了抗议。

ex.en: The measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
ex.zh: 当城市不得不自行治理空气污染时，其必须采取的措施在政治上存在争议，因此容易受到攻击。

ex.en: The decision to close the village school proved highly controversial.
ex.zh: 关闭乡村学校的决定极富争议。

ex.en: Genetic editing of human embryos remains one of the most controversial issues in science.
ex.zh: 人类胚胎基因编辑仍是科学界最具争议的问题之一。

controversy.usage: 辨析:controversy指公开的激烈争论;argument指提理由说服对方;debate指为辨清真理的辩论;dispute常有目的性,可作争夺;quarrel指争吵；词根记忆：contra(against,反对)+vers(turn,调转)+y→因反对而调转方向→争论；controversy 争议；argument

ex.en: They fueled a lot of controversy.
ex.zh: 他们引发了许多争论。

ex.en: The world art market brings together great wealth, enormous egos, greed, passion and controversy in a way matched by few other industries.
ex.zh: 世界艺术品市场汇集了少有行业能够相媲美的巨大的财富、庞大的自我价值、贪婪、激情和争论。

ex.en: The new policy caused great controversy.
ex.zh: 新政策引起了巨大争议。

senses: v. 召集,召开(正式会议)
v. (为正式会议而)聚集,集合

ex.en: The committee will convene next Monday to review the evidence collected during the six-month investigation.
ex.zh: 委员会将于下周一召开会议，审查为期六个月的调查所收集的证据。
